title: Prevent full app reset when changing UI language
context: RootView applies .id(appLanguage) to AgentScreen. Changing locale destroys and recreates the complete screen subtree, reruns RootView.task, repeats session discovery and may prepare/load the active model again. This creates avoidable work for a presentation preference change.
goal: Apply locale changes through SwiftUI environment updates without resetting the entire AgentScreen identity or rerunning startup/model preparation.
forbidden_changes: Do not change language preference keys or translations.
Do not change model load/unload behavior or session refresh semantics.
Do not redesign the UI or modify unrelated screens.
acceptance_criteria: Changing app.language updates the environment locale without changing AgentScreen identity.
The root startup task is not re-triggered solely by changing language.
The diff contains only the targeted identity-reset removal and this task contract.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Review RootView diff to confirm .id(appLanguage) is removed and .environment(\.locale, ...) remains.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if locale switching no longer updates visible localized content.
